sentences.text:
Considering the fact that the husband (petitioner's son) as well as complainant/wife are resident of Australia and the complainant/wife has never permanently resided in the matrimonial home and further keeping in view that the age of the petitioner is 70 yrs, it is directed that no coercive action shall be taken against the petitioner.
8. Reply, if any, be filed before the next date.
9. In the meanwhile, the petitioner shall join the investigation as and when directed by the Investigating Officer (I.O)/SHO concerned.
10. Renotify on 14.08.2023.
VIKAS MAHAJAN, J MAY 17, 2023/
